enriched_steps.what_changes: Lock the exact protocol manifest, split hashes, frozen MiniLM encoder checkpoint hash, seed list, candidate `K` grid, and the selection constants `epsilon_cov`, `rho_risk`, `radius_quantile`, and `wilson_alpha` into a read-only run-spec object. Refuse to proceed if any artifact hash or split file differs from the manifest, and record the detector version plus the exact output schema for later audit.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Freeze the protocol manifest, split hashes, frozen MiniLM checkpoint, seed list, candidate `K` grid, and the selection constants `epsilon_cov`, `rho_risk`, `radius_quantile`, and `wilson_alpha` into a read-only run spec. Abort if any artifact hash or split file differs from the manifest, and record the detector version and output schema for later audit.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把协议清单、划分哈希、冻结的 MiniLM 检查点、种子列表、候选 `K` 网格，以及 `epsilon_cov`、`rho_risk`、`radius_quantile` 和 `wilson_alpha` 这些选择常数写入只读运行规格。若任何工件哈希或划分文件与清单不一致就中止，并记录检测器版本和输出格式，便于后续审计。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Embed `train_known` utterances with the frozen MiniLM encoder, L2-normalize every vector, and fit deterministic `K-means (KMeans)` centers for each intent. For every non-target intent, fit one center and one radius once; for the target intent `y`, sweep `K ∈ {1,2,3,4}` with `n_init=20`, `max_iter=300`, and `random_state=seed`, then set each radius `r_{y,k}` to the 95th percentile of the within-cluster Euclidean distances with a floor of `1e-6`. Define `A_{y,K}(x)=1` iff `min_k q_{y,k}(x) ≤ 1`, where `q_{y,k}(x)=d(z(x),c_{y,k})/r_{y,k}`, and cache a geometry table with one row per `(intent_id, K, center_id)` containing `center_vector`, `radius`, `assigned_count`, and `mean_incluster_distance`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Embed `train_known` utterances with the frozen MiniLM encoder, L2-normalize every vector, and fit deterministic `K-means (KMeans)` centers for each intent. For every non-target intent, fit one center and one radius once; for the target intent `y`, sweep `K ∈ {1,2,3,4}` with `n_init=20`, `max_iter=300`, and `random_state=seed`, then set each radius `r_{y,k}` to the 95th percentile of the within-cluster Euclidean distances with a floor of `1e-6`. Define `A_{y,K}(x)=1` iff `min_k q_{y,k}(x) ≤ 1`, where `q_{y,k}(x)=d(z(x),c_{y,k})/r_{y,k}`, and cache a geometry table with one row per `(intent_id, K, center_id)` containing `center_vector`, `radius`, `assigned_count`, and `mean_incluster_distance`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 用冻结的 MiniLM 编码器把 `train_known` 里的句子向量化，并对每个向量做 L2 归一化，然后为每个意图拟合确定性的 `K-means (KMeans)` 中心。对非目标意图，只拟合一次单中心和单半径；对目标意图 `y`，在 `K ∈ {1,2,3,4}` 上扫描，使用 `n_init=20`、`max_iter=300`、`random_state=seed`，再把每个半径 `r_{y,k}` 设为该簇内欧氏距离的第 95 百分位，并加上 `1e-6` 的下界。定义 `A_{y,K}(x)=1` 当且仅当 `min_k q_{y,k}(x) ≤ 1`，其中 `q_{y,k}(x)=d(z(x),c_{y,k})/r_{y,k}`，并缓存一张几何表，每行对应 `(intent_id, K, center_id)`，记录 `center_vector`、`radius`、`assigned_count` 和 `mean_incluster_distance`。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For each target intent `y`, create one episode for every other known intent `h` by holding out all of `h`'s calibration samples as construction-defined pseudo-out-of-scope (OOS) examples and never using them in fitting or threshold search. Keep the rotation unit at the intent level, not the sentence level, and record each episode as `(target_y, heldout_h, sample_ids, embedding_rows, true_label=h, episode_weight)`; if a held-out intent has no calibration samples, skip it and mark the episode `empty`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For each target intent `y`, create one episode for every other known intent `h` by holding out all of `h`'s calibration samples as construction-defined pseudo-out-of-scope (OOS) examples and never using them in fitting or threshold search. Keep the rotation unit at the intent level, not the sentence level, and record each episode as `(target_y, heldout_h, sample_ids, embedding_rows, true_label=h, episode_weight)`; if a held-out intent has no calibration samples, skip it and mark the episode `empty`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对每个目标意图 `y`，把其他每个已知意图 `h` 都单独做成一个轮换 episode：完整拿出 `h` 的校准样本，作为构造定义的伪 out-of-scope (OOS) 样本，并且不把它们用于拟合或阈值搜索。轮换的单位保持在意图层面，不降到句子层面；每个 episode 记录为 `(target_y, heldout_h, sample_ids, embedding_rows, true_label=h, episode_weight)`。如果某个留出意图没有校准样本，就跳过并标记该 episode 为 `empty`。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For each candidate `K`, score every sample in the episode table twice: once with the frozen `K=1` gate and once with the target-specific `K` gate. Define `I_{y,K,h}(x)=1` when the expanded gate accepts a pseudo-OOS sample but the `K=1` baseline rejects it; estimate `ΔU_{y,K}` as the pooled new-acceptance rate across all eligible episodes, compute the one-sided Wilson upper bound `UCB_{y,K}` with `wilson_alpha=0.05` (`z=1.645`), and compute `G_{y,K}` as the accepted fraction on `y`'s own calibration samples using the same gate. If the pooled denominator is zero, set both `ΔU_{y,K}` and `UCB_{y,K}` to `0` and carry a `zero_episode` flag into the result row.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For each candidate `K`, score every sample in the episode table twice: once with the frozen `K=1` gate and once with the target-specific `K` gate. Define `I_{y,K,h}(x)=1` when the expanded gate accepts a pseudo-OOS sample but the `K=1` baseline rejects it; estimate `ΔU_{y,K}` as the pooled new-acceptance rate across all eligible episodes, compute the one-sided Wilson upper bound `UCB_{y,K}` with `wilson_alpha=0.05` (`z=1.645`), and compute `G_{y,K}` as the accepted fraction on `y`'s own calibration samples using the same gate. If the pooled denominator is zero, set both `ΔU_{y,K}` and `UCB_{y,K}` to `0` and carry a `zero_episode` flag into the result row.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对每个候选 `K`，把 episode 表里的每个样本都打两次分：一次用冻结的 `K=1` 门，一次用目标专属的 `K` 门。定义 `I_{y,K,h}(x)=1` 为扩展后的门接受了一个伪 OOS 样本、而 `K=1` 基线拒绝了它；把所有可用 episode 的新增接受率汇总起来估计 `ΔU_{y,K}`，用 `wilson_alpha=0.05` 的单侧 Wilson 上界（`z=1.645`）计算 `UCB_{y,K}`，并用同一个门在 `y` 自己的校准样本上计算 `G_{y,K}`，即被接受的比例。若汇总分母为 `0`，就把 `ΔU_{y,K}` 和 `UCB_{y,K}` 都设为 `0`，并在结果行里带上 `zero_episode` 标记。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For each intent `y`, scan `K ∈ {1,2,3,4}` in descending order, keep the largest `K` satisfying `G_{y,K} ≥ G_{y,1} − epsilon_cov` and `UCB_{y,K} ≤ rho_risk`, and emit `selected_K_y`, `selection_reason`, `G_selected`, and `UCB_selected`. If no candidate passes, return `K=1` with reason code `fallback_risk` when the risk bound fails, `fallback_coverage` when coverage fails, or `fallback_empty` when the episode table is empty.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For each intent `y`, scan `K ∈ {1,2,3,4}` in descending order, keep the largest `K` satisfying `G_{y,K} ≥ G_{y,1} − epsilon_cov` and `UCB_{y,K} ≤ rho_risk`, and emit `selected_K_y`, `selection_reason`, `G_selected`, and `UCB_selected`. If no candidate passes, return `K=1` with reason code `fallback_risk` when the risk bound fails, `fallback_coverage` when coverage fails, or `fallback_empty` when the episode table is empty.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对每个意图 `y`，按降序扫描 `K ∈ {1,2,3,4}`，保留满足 `G_{y,K} ≥ G_{y,1} − epsilon_cov` 且 `UCB_{y,K} ≤ rho_risk` 的最大 `K`，并输出 `selected_K_y`、`selection_reason`、`G_selected` 和 `UCB_selected`。如果没有任何候选通过，就回退到 `K=1`；当风险上界不过关时记为 `fallback_risk`，当覆盖不过关时记为 `fallback_coverage`，当 episode 表为空时记为 `fallback_empty`。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Fit a separate global geometry-calibrated abstention comparator on the same train/calibration contract by taking `m(x)=min_y min_k q_{y,k}(x)` and grid-searching a single threshold `τ_geo` over observed calibration values to maximize calibration `F1-All` while satisfying the same `epsilon_cov` coverage floor. The comparator predicts the nearest intent if `m(x) ≤ τ_geo`; otherwise it abstains to OOS. Store `τ_geo`, calibration `F1-All`, and the same test metrics as URCSG in a separate result block so it cannot change any selected `K_y`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Fit a separate global geometry-calibrated abstention comparator on the same train/calibration contract by taking `m(x)=min_y min_k q_{y,k}(x)` and grid-searching a single threshold `τ_geo` over observed calibration values to maximize calibration `F1-All` while satisfying the same `epsilon_cov` coverage floor. The comparator predicts the nearest intent if `m(x) ≤ τ_geo`; otherwise it abstains to OOS. Store `τ_geo`, calibration `F1-All`, and the same test metrics as URCSG in a separate result block so it cannot change any selected `K_y`.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在同一套训练/校准契约下，单独拟合一个全局几何校准拒识比较器：先计算 `m(x)=min_y min_k q_{y,k}(x)`，再在观测到的校准值上网格搜索一个单一阈值 `τ_geo`，目标是在满足同样的 `epsilon_cov` 覆盖下限时，让校准集上的 `F1-All` 最大。这个比较器在 `m(x) ≤ τ_geo` 时预测最近的意图，否则就拒识为 OOS。把 `τ_geo`、校准 `F1-All` 和与 URCSG 相同的测试指标单独存成一个结果块，避免它改动任何已选的 `K_y`。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Freeze `selected_K_y` and `τ_geo`, run one untouched test pass, and compute `Known Recall`, `OOS Recall`, `F1-All`, and false acceptance rate on the held-out test pools. For each sample, score all intents with the frozen geometry, choose the accepted intent with the smallest normalized distance, break ties by the smallest intent ID, and abstain to OOS when no intent is accepted.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Freeze `selected_K_y` and `τ_geo`, run one untouched test pass, and compute `Known Recall`, `OOS Recall`, `F1-All`, and false acceptance rate on the held-out test pools. For each sample, score all intents with the frozen geometry, choose the accepted intent with the smallest normalized distance, break ties by the smallest intent ID, and abstain to OOS when no intent is accepted.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 冻结 `selected_K_y` 和 `τ_geo`，只跑一次不再改动的测试评估，并在留出的测试池上计算 `Known Recall`、`OOS Recall`、`F1-All` 和 false acceptance rate。对每个样本，用冻结后的几何对所有意图打分，选取归一化距离最小且被接受的意图；如果有并列，就取意图 ID 最小的那个；如果没有任何意图被接受，就拒识为 OOS。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Before any risk computation, apply one seeded permutation to the held-out intent IDs across the episode table, keep the sample rows and counts unchanged, rerun S4–S7, and log the resulting negative-control `ΔU`, `UCB`, `selected_K_y`, and test metrics. The shuffle acts only on the episode-to-intent mapping, not on the embeddings or labels inside each sample row.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Before any risk computation, apply one seeded permutation to the held-out intent IDs across the episode table, keep the sample rows and counts unchanged, rerun S4–S7, and log the resulting negative-control `ΔU`, `UCB`, `selected_K_y`, and test metrics. The shuffle acts only on the episode-to-intent mapping, not on the embeddings or labels inside each sample row.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在做任何风险计算之前，先对 episode 表里的留出意图 ID 做一次带种子的置换，保持样本行和计数不变，再重复 S4–S7，并记录负对照下的 `ΔU`、`UCB`、`selected_K_y` 和测试指标。这个打乱只作用在 episode 到意图的映射上，不改动每个样本行里的向量或标签。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Assemble a paired comparison table for `Single`, `fixed K=2`, `BRAK`, `oracle-test-K`, the global comparator, the shuffled negative control, and URCSG, all on the same dataset/seed splits. Report per-run and aggregate means for the same metrics as S7 plus the selected `K` distribution, and compute paired deltas against URCSG so the claim is read as a mechanism test, not a leaderboard sweep.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Assemble a paired comparison table for `Single`, `fixed K=2`, `BRAK`, `oracle-test-K`, the global comparator, the shuffled negative control, and URCSG, all on the same dataset/seed splits. Report per-run and aggregate means for the same metrics as S7 plus the selected `K` distribution, and compute paired deltas against URCSG so the claim is read as a mechanism test, not a leaderboard sweep.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 把 `Single`、`fixed K=2`、`BRAK`、`oracle-test-K`、全局比较器、打乱后的负对照和 URCSG 放到同一张配对比较表里，所有结果都来自相同的数据集/种子划分。报告与 S7 相同的指标在单次运行和汇总后的均值，再加上 `selected K` 的分布，并计算相对 URCSG 的配对差值，让结论被读成一次机制检验，而不是排行榜式的搜参。
